page.content:
Hero's handbook that later becomes a key to worlds.

How Enchiridion connects

  • Character: Finn the Human — Finn seeks and later carries the Enchiridion.
  • Character: The Lich — The Lich wants the Enchiridion as a key.

What is Enchiridion?

The Enchiridion is the hero manual Finn seeks early on, later revealed as a lock-book that can open paths the Lich wants.

Key threads lead to Finn the Human and The Lich.
